title: The Perfect First Call
objective: Master the 3-step formula for winning customers on the first call

slides.title: First Impressions Matter
slides.content: The first 30 seconds of your call determine whether you'll win or lose the job. In this quick module, you'll learn the proven 3-step formula used by top-performing roofers.
slides.keyTakeaway: You never get a second chance to make a first impression

slides.title: Step 1: The Professional Greeting
slides.content: Always start with: 'Thank you for calling [Company]. This is [Your Name]. I'm here to help you with your roofing needs. May I have your name please?'

quiz.question: What should you say first on a customer call?
options: Thank them for calling and introduce yourself
quiz.explanation: Always thank them first and introduce yourself professionally. This builds immediate trust and rapport.

slides.title: Step 2: Listen & Empathize
slides.content: After they explain their situation, respond with: 'I understand how concerning that must be. Let me help you figure out the best solution.'
slides.keyTakeaway: People buy from those who understand their problems

slides.title: Step 3: Book the Inspection
slides.content: Don't give prices over the phone. Instead say: 'I'd like to come out and give you a free, no-obligation inspection. I have availability tomorrow at 10am or 2pm. Which works better for you?'
slides.keyTakeaway: Always offer two specific times - it doubles your booking rate

quiz.question: Why shouldn't you give prices over the phone?
options: Every roof is different and needs inspection
Customers always hang up after hearing prices
quiz.explanation: Every roof is unique. Giving prices without inspection leads to inaccurate quotes and lost trust. Always inspect first.

slides.title: Practice Makes Perfect
slides.content: Now that you know the formula, practice it 10 times out loud before your next call. Top performers rehearse until it becomes natural.
